# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `scale4-ai` MCP server pointing at Scale4's hosted HTTP endpoint (`https://mcp.scale4.app/mcp_scale4_plugin`).
- Logo is referenced by the publisher-submitted URL (`https://mcp.scale4.tools/playstore.svg`); no local image is committed yet.
